title: THE UNKNOWN EARTH
subtitle: Unmapped hydrological systems and planetary respiration.
editorialNote: In this issue, we journey three kilometers beneath the Antarctic ice sheet into Lake Mercer, chart the continent-spanning atmospheric rivers produced by the Siberian Taiga, and look to the vanishing frontiers of zero-light skies.

title: FRONTIERS OF ICE
subtitle: Apex predators and survival across the polar extremes.
editorialNote: Svalbard's melting sea floes test the evolutionary plasticity of polar bear lineages, while autonomous ocean gliders measure Atlantic water intrusion beneath Greenland's marine-terminating glaciers.

title: BURIED EMPIRES
subtitle: Radar archaeology and ancient trade corridors in the desert.
editorialNote: Satellite synthetic aperture radar penetrates the Rub' al Khali sand dunes to uncover an interconnected prehistoric water system, while indigenous guardians deploy bio-acoustic edge sensors in Ecuador.

stories.title: The Last Light of the Desert
stories.author: Chloé Dubois

title: THE HADAL REALM
subtitle: Extreme pressure biology eight kilometers down.
editorialNote: Humanity has sent twelve people to the Moon, but fewer have visited the hadal trenches. We chronicle the submersible descent into the Puerto Rico Trench and sperm whale linguistics.

stories.title: The Acoustic Secret of Sperm Whales
stories.author: Maya Sørensen

title: QUANTUM EARTH
subtitle: Subatomic principles orchestrating living organisms.
editorialNote: How quantum coherence enables avian magnetoreception, and the search for prebiotic chemical architectures inside meteoritic carbonaceous chondrites.

title: SACRED BEDROCK
subtitle: Subterranean architecture of medieval Ethiopia.
editorialNote: A photographic exploration of the monolithic rock churches of Lalibela, followed by the nocturnal transformation of modern urban megacities.
